Test-only RSA-2048 keypair generated by the previous `rsa`-crate key generator
(PKCS#1 `RSAPrivateKey` DER + SPKI public DER, base64) and its JWK `n`/`e`.
Used to prove keys already stored by older ferrox-cp releases still sign and
publish an identical JWKS after the switch to aws-lc-rs. Never used outside tests.
